caseName: Chicago, Kalamazoo & Saginaw Railway Co. v. Kindlesparker
caseNameFull: Chicago, Kalamazoo & Saginaw Railway Company, in Error v. Gale Kindlesparker
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for ■the Sixth . Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Stuart E. Knappen and Mr. Frank E. Robson for plaintiff in error., Mr. Charles F. Hext and Mr. H. Monroe Dunham for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed with costs, and case remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Western District of. Michigan for further proceedings, upon the authority of Minneapolis & St. Louis R. R. Co. v. Winters, 242 U. S. 353.
